answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the relic binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 3 separate vaults needs a separate funded beacon account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and therefore the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The forge explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 404 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital.
